top.definitionKo: 어떤 기준보다 더 높은 쪽. 또는 중간보다 더 높은 쪽.
top.englishDescription: A higher position than a certain standard; a higher position than the middle.

top.definitionKo: 길고 높은 것의 꼭대기나 꼭대기에 가까운 곳.
top.englishDescription: The top of a long or tall thing, or a place close to the top.
The outside or flat surface of something.

top.definitionKo: 어떤 물체의 꼭대기에서 앞쪽이 되는 부분.
top.englishDescription: The topmost part of an object that serves as its front.
A person who is the best in a certain area.
The highest point.
(figurative) The topmost part of something.
The highest.

top.definitionKo: 둥글고 짧은 몸통의 한쪽 끝을 뾰족하게 깎아서 심을 박아 만든, 돌리면서 노는 장난감.
top.englishDescription: A toy, whipped to spin, with a round and short body, which is made by sharpening one end of its body and inserting a tip.

top.definitionKo: 신분, 등급 등의 차례 가운데 가장 높은 자리.
top.englishDescription: The highest place in status, rank, etc.

touting.definitionKo: 물건 등을 팔기 위해 손님을 부름.
touting.englishDescription: An act of hailing a potential customer to sell goods, etc.

treaty.definitionKo: 국가 간의 합의에 따라 세부적인 항목을 세워 서로의 권리와 의무를 정한 약속. 또는 그런 문서.
treaty.englishDescription: An agreement between countries that stipulates the parties' rights and obligations in specific provisions, or such a document.

treaty.definitionKo: 한 국가가 다른 국가와 약정을 맺음. 또는 그 약정.
treaty.englishDescription: A state of making an agreement with another country; or the agreement.

treaty.definitionKo: 공동의 목적을 이루기 위해 여러 사람이 의논하여 약속을 맺음. 또는 그 약속.
treaty.englishDescription: A state in which many people reach an agreement through discussion to accomplish a common goal; or the agreement.

trigger.definitionKo: 어떤 것이 원인이 되어 다른 사건이나 현상을 일어나게 하다.
trigger.englishDescription: To make something become the cause of another accident or phenomenon.

trigger.definitionKo: (비유적으로) 중요한 일이 잘될 수 있도록 하는 데에 먼저 필요한 것.
trigger.englishDescription: (figurative) A thing needed as a catalyst for making important things go well.
(figurative) A cause of a fight or trouble.

trigger.definitionKo: 집게손가락으로 잡아당겨 총알이 나가도록 하는, 총 아랫부분에 달린 굽은 쇠 모양 장치.
trigger.englishDescription: The curved metallic lever attached at the lower part of a gun that is pulled by the index finger to fire a bullet.

trigger.definitionKo: 어떤 일을 당해 감정이나 충동 등이 일어남. 또는 그렇게 되게 함.
trigger.englishDescription: The state of an emotion, urge, etc., being aroused; or an act of making this happen.

trigger.definitionKo: 어떤 일을 당해 감정이나 충동 등이 일어나다. 또는 그렇게 되게 하다.
trigger.englishDescription: For an emotion, urge, etc., to be aroused; or to make this happen.

trouble-free.englishDescription: Living peacefully without any problem or accident.

ttakji.definitionKo: 두꺼운 종이에 그림이나 글자를 넣거나, 종이를 네모나게 접어 만든 장난감.
ttakji.englishDescription: A toy made by inserting a picture or letters in a thick piece of paper or folding it in a square shape.

tweet-tweet.definitionKo: 참새나 제비 등의 작은 새가 지저귀는 소리.
tweet-tweet.englishDescription: In the manner of a small bird such as a sparrow, swallow, etc., chirping.

unfasten.definitionKo: 채워진 단추나 잠긴 자물쇠 등을 열다.
unfasten.englishDescription: To open a fastened button, lock, etc.

unforeseen.definitionKo: 전혀 예상하거나 생각하지 못한 데가 있다.
unforeseen.englishDescription: Having something that one has never expected or thought.

unhesitating.definitionKo: 일을 처리하는 방식이나 성격이 매우 시원스럽다.
unhesitating.englishDescription: One's way of handling a task or personality being very unhesitating without reserve.

unhesitating.definitionKo: 성격이나 목소리 등이 시원시원하고 마음이 넓다.
unhesitating.englishDescription: One's personality being generous or straightforward, or one's voice sounding powerful.

uproarious.englishDescription: Noisy as a lot of people talk.

uproarious.definitionKo: 말이나 행동이 가볍고 조심성이 없으며 야단스럽다.
uproarious.englishDescription: Acting or speaking in an imprudent, careless, and boisterous manner.

urine.definitionKo: 혈액 속의 노폐물과 수분이 요도를 통하여 몸 밖으로 배출되는, 누렇고 지린내가 나는 액체.
urine.englishDescription: Yellowish, smelly liquid which is the discharge of waste and water in the blood from the body through the urethra.

vanishingly.definitionKo: 사라져 어디로 갔는지 알 수가 없게.
vanishingly.englishDescription: Disappearing so as for one's whereabouts to be unknown to others.

ventilate.englishDescription: For air, etc., to come to flow freely.
For air, etc., to flow freely.

ventilate.definitionKo: 더럽고 탁한 공기를 맑은 공기로 바꾸다.
ventilate.englishDescription: To change dirty, stuffy air into fresh air.

victimize.definitionKo: 어떤 사람이나 목적을 위해 목숨, 재산, 명예, 이익 등을 바치거나 버리게 하다.
victimize.englishDescription: To make someone give away or relinquish his/her life, property, reputation, interest, etc., for the benefit of someone else or some cause.

viscosity.englishDescription: The quality of a substance being gluey and sticky.

wander.englishDescription: To travel around to lots of places.
To go out and wander about here and there.

wander.definitionKo: 어디에 속하거나 마음을 두지 못하고 바깥으로 돌아다니다.
wander.englishDescription: To be unable to belong to or settle in one place, but to wander about.

wander.definitionKo: 정한 곳 없이 이곳저곳을 옮겨 다니다.
wander.englishDescription: To move from place to place, without a fixed place to stay.

wander.definitionKo: 한곳에 오래 머물지 않고 이곳저곳을 옮겨 다니다.
wander.englishDescription: To move from place to place, not staying long in one place.
To wander around without a destination.

wander.definitionKo: 목표나 방향을 정하지 못하여 어찌할 바를 모르고 헤매다.
wander.englishDescription: To fail to set a goal or direction and get lost, not knowing what to do.
To wander around without a place to go.
For one's thought to change continuously; for one's consciousness to be lost intermittently.
To go about from place to place.
To wander after losing a goal or direction.

wander.definitionKo: 생활이나 마음을 다잡지 못하고 자꾸 헤매다.
wander.englishDescription: To keep wandering without composing one's mind or having a grip on one's own life.

warship.definitionKo: 해군에 소속되어 있는, 전투에 참여하는 배.
warship.englishDescription: A naval ship that is used in battles.

washroom.definitionKo: 얼굴을 씻을 수 있도록 시설을 갖추어 놓은 방.
washroom.englishDescription: A room with facilities where one can wash one's face.

washroom.definitionKo: 얼굴을 씻을 수 있도록 시설을 갖추어 놓은 곳.
washroom.englishDescription: A place equipped with facilities where one can wash one's face.

wavelength.definitionKo: 전파나 음파의 파동에서, 같은 위상을 가진 서로 이웃한 두 점 사이의 거리.
wavelength.englishDescription: In radio or sound waves, the distance between two neighboring dots in the same phase.

wharf.definitionKo: 배를 대어 사람이 오르내리거나 짐을 싣고 내릴 수 있도록 시설을 마련해 놓은 곳.
wharf.englishDescription: A structure equipped with facilities that provide access to ships so that they can load or unload cargo or passengers.

wild-looking.definitionKo: 모양이나 상태가 매우 거칠고 사나운 데가 있다.
wild-looking.englishDescription: An appearance or situation looking very rough and menacing.

wonsam.definitionKo: 한복의 하나로, 주로 신부나 궁궐의 높은 여인들이 입었던 옷.
wonsam.englishDescription: A traditional Korean ceremonial dress, worn mainly by brides or high-ranking court ladies.

yaksik.definitionKo: 찹쌀에 꿀, 설탕, 대추, 간장, 참기름, 밤, 잣 등을 섞어서 찐 음식.
yaksik.englishExpression: yaksik; sweet rice with nuts and jujubes
yaksik.englishDescription: A dish made by steaming glutinous rice mixed with honey, sugar, jujubes, soy sauce, sesame oil, chestnuts, pine nuts, etc.

yeollyeo.englishDescription: virtuous widow: A woman who keeps her chastity after her husband's death.

yoreogo.englishDescription: An abbreviated word for '요리하고' (a conjugated form of '요리하다' (do this way)).

yujacha.definitionKo: 설탕이나 꿀에 절인 유자를 뜨거운 물에 타서 마시는 차.
yujacha.englishDescription: A tea made by mixing hot water with citron preserved in sugar or honey.
